statement: This sketch depicts a continuously operating sawmill mechanism in a 3D space. Cylindrical logs are fed into a rotating sawblade that cuts them into rectangular planks. The resulting planks fall from the machinery and accumulate at the bottom of the scene, creating a growing, chaotic pile. The visualization uses WebGL rendering for three-dimensional effects, with physics simulation including gravity and rotation to animate the falling planks. The scene features a constant cycle of log input, cutting, and plank accumulation that creates an organic, dynamic heap forming over time.
